contract.approval: Parent explicitly approved this additive method after reviewing RED evidence and the checkpoint design.
contract.existingPublicMethods: createDraft, preview, apply, undo and redo retain their signatures and behavior. Preview does not mutate or implicitly advance a draft.
contract.ownership: An exact issued frozen preview is held in a controller-private WeakMap as the continuation checkpoint. Its editable copy is returned through a newly issued draft handle. Raw/copied wrappers and copied output do not establish authority.
contract.baseline: Continuation preserves the original full live-project and identity fingerprint. Only protected-field comparison uses the genuine immutable checkpoint; final impact compares the complete proposal against the original live project.
contract.consumption: Continuation uses the same applied WeakSet guard as apply, including the parent-provided in-flight reservation. Foreign, fabricated, stale, accepted and in-flight previews reject. No apply-path change in this fix.
contract.helper: editAuthoringDraft obtains and preserves the new issued continuation handle. Earlier compile/delete/clone results and source edits remain in the detached proposal; no operation replay, automatic acceptance or weakened ownership guard.

regressionCoverage: Both exact independent compile/delete-preview then ordinary title-edit cases
Multiple compile/delete continuations preserve earlier source edits and generated/deletion intent without touching live state
Original complete map/occurrence/event impact survives continuation; one acceptance plus one undo/redo restores exact before/after projects
Clone-design preview permits editing the new clone and later metadata without replaying the clone or modifying its source
Manual maps/bindings reject after genuine compilation; exact generated output copied into a fresh raw draft still rejects
Foreign preview and copied/fabricated checkpoints reject, including modified raster copies
Editable continuation mutation cannot rewrite its private frozen checkpoint

Accepted changed and no-op previews remain spent; final continued preview cannot be applied or continued again
Synchronous observer undo cannot continue an in-flight preview; unchanged reentrancy controls remain green

review.tests: Behavior assertions only, no prose pins, sleeps or polling. Real synchronous integration; test timers contain existing scheduling and are reset after each case.
